pages.title: Bose-Einstein Condenser
pages.text: Day 22. Cooled atoms to nanokelvin until they shared a single quantum state - a Bose-Einstein condensate, predicted in 1925, first made in 1995.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

What happens: near absolute zero each atom's wavelength grows until neighbours overlap, and bosons pile into the lowest state together, acting as one giant matter wave. The $(item)Bose-Einstein Condenser$() does it to order.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bose-Einstein Condensate, Cryocooler Unit, False Vacuum, Metallic Hydrogen Ingot, Nanite Slurry, Psionic Ether, Quantum-Dot Photoresist, Superconducting Solder, Superfluid Helium, Synaptic Fluid, Warm Helium.
